Glands of 1-2-day-old calling virgin females excised 7 h into photophase (the authors chose that time because virgins call in the photophase; that the extracted females were calling is not stated), 10 ul hexane for 10 min. DMDS adducts located the 3,13 positions in the acetates (18 female equivalents) but did not resolve geometry; geometry rests on retention indices on two columns. The authors presume the two alcohols are precursors of the two acetates: an author hypothesis, not a measured conversion.
